_how: Answers worked out by hand before running. Wet width = fired / (1 - s). Mug: wet capacity = ml / (1 - s)^3, inner radius = wet width/2 - wall, inner height = wet capacity / (pi r^2), wet height = that + base, clay = pi R^2 H - wet capacity, grams = clay x 1.95, weigh out = grams x (1 + allowance). Bowl: cap volume pi h (3a^2 + h^2) / 6, outside minus inside. Plate: pi r0^2 base + pi (R + r0) H sqrt2 wall, with r0 = R - H. Walls, base and allowance are the per-pot defaults. Weigh-out rounds to 10 g.
